hook_candidates.headline: Bank matching: 3 hours down to 5-10 minutes
hook_candidates.sub: OpenAI story, October 20, 2026. ChatGPT Work is a ChatGPT tool for business files.

caption:
Ted Taylor runs three Schlotzsky's and Cinnabon restaurants in New Mexico. In an OpenAI customer story from October 20, 2026, he says ChatGPT Work cut his monthly cash reconciliation from three hours to 5-10 minutes.

How he does it: he uploads each store's cash transactions and bank records, and ChatGPT Work matches the transactions to the deposits. He also uses it to reprice his menus, in 1-2 hours instead of 5 days.

His rule is the useful part: give it the same data you would use yourself, compare its answer with how you would do it, and always review the result before acting on it.

Try this with your own files:
"Match each bank deposit to the sales day it belongs to. Flag any difference over $5 and list the days that do not balance."

Source: https://openai.com/index/ted-taylor-restaurant
